summary.text: In Indian agricultural economics (Directorate of Economics & Statistics / ICAR-AICRP on Sesame and Niger, JNKVV Jabalpur / TRIFED), Niger Seed (Guizotia abyssinica, locally known as Ramtil, Kala Til, Khursani, Gurellu, or Karale) is a minor, dryland, and high-value tribal oilseed crop. Globally, India and Ethiopia are the only two significant producers and exporters of niger seed, with India accounting for roughly 45% to 50% of commercial global production.

protection.name: Cuscuta / Dodder (Cuscuta campestris, C. chinensis)
protection.geography: National Export Rejection Threat (Severe in Odisha, MP, CG)
protection.impact: Obligate stem parasite; leafless, golden-yellow, thread-like twining vines parasitize niger stems, penetrating vascular bundles with haustoria; stunts crop growth; produces thousands of tiny seeds that contaminate harvested niger lots; causes complete export rejection by the USDA.
protection.passage: Niger Seeds — source table 186, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Alternaria Leaf Spot & Blight (Alternaria porri f. sp. guizotiae)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in warm, humid spells)
protection.impact: Small, dark brown-to-black circular spots with concentric rings on leaves; lesions coalesce, causing foliar drying, stem cankers, and black flower head rot; causes premature defoliation and flower drop; reduces seed yield by 20–40%.
protection.passage: Niger Seeds — source table 186, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Niger Caterpillar / Semilooper (Perigea capensis / Condica capensis)
protection.impact: Dark green caterpillars with white longitudinal stripes feed voraciously on leaves, tender buds, and open flower heads; chew irregular holes; can defoliate entire young crops.
protection.passage: Niger Seeds — source table 186, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Powdery Mildew (Oidium guizotiae, Sphaerotheca)
protection.impact: White, powdery fungal patches appear on upper leaf surfaces and stems; spreads across the canopy, causing leaves to turn chlorotic, dry up, and shed prematurely; impairs flower set.
protection.passage: Niger Seeds — source table 186, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Aphids & Dipsocoris Bugs (Aphis gossypii, Taylorilygus)
protection.impact: Small colonies of aphids and plant bugs cluster on flower peduncles and young capitula; suck sap; cause floral heads to shrivel and abort, resulting in sterile, seedless heads.
protection.passage: Niger Seeds — source table 186, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Rust-Red Flour Beetle & Cigarette Beetle (Tribolium castaneum, Lasioderma)
protection.impact: Beetles bore into broken or damaged achenes; feed on fatty cotyledons; causes oil rancidity, bad odors, and packaging contamination.
